reviews.t: Great results for an excellent price!!!
reviews.x: Product arrived exactly as described.  Includes a heat glove.  Adjustable heat setting (Low to High). It was much easier to use than I imagined.  My hair didn't get stuck to the wand or slide off like it does sometimes with a regular curling iron. I used high heat and it didnt burn my hair.  I have fine hair that doesn't hold curl well but this wand managed to get the job done. For such a reasonable cost ($23), I'm surprised this worked so well.  I would definitely recommend this product!!!

claims.text: Works well even on hair that typically won't hold a curl, such as fine, straight hair.
Easy to use, even for people who aren't skilled at styling their hair.
Takes practice and can be time-consuming or difficult to learn, especially without a clamp.
Produces pretty curls and waves with good results.
The included glove is problematic—too big and hard to feel through, leading to burns.

qa.q: Does the jumbo barrel actually create loose waves or just straighten my hair?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: several users with straight hair report it creates beachy waves or strong curls [1][2][3][4], while one reviewer says it only produces a braid-like wave rather than a real curl [5].

claims.text: Some reviewers with naturally straight hair report beachy waves or strong curls from the tool.
One reviewer says it makes hair look like a braid wave rather than a better curl.

qa.q: How hot does it get and is it safe for fine or damaged hair?
qa.answer: The iron has an adjustable heat setting from low to high, and one reviewer said it got hot enough to curl thick ethnic hair [3][4]. A reviewer with fine hair used high heat and said it didn't burn their hair [4], but no review directly addresses damaged hair.

claims.text: The iron has an adjustable heat setting from low to high.
It got hot enough to curl thick ethnic hair.
A reviewer with fine hair used high heat and said it didn't burn their hair.

qa.q: Is the barrel size too big for short hair?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it works on short hair, with one noting her above-shoulder thin hair curled well [1] and another saying it works on short or long hair [2], while another explicitly states it is "Not for short hair" and requires at least shoulder length [3].

claims.text: One reviewer with above-shoulder, straight, thin hair says the wand works wonders on short hair [1].
Another reviewer says it works on short or long hair [2].
A third reviewer states it is not for short hair and requires at least shoulder length [3].

qa.q: Does it have an auto shut-off in case I forget to turn it off?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it worth the price compared to a regular curling iron?
qa.answer: Reviews suggest it's worth it: one calls it an "Excellent price" [1], and others say it works better than regular irons for hard-to-curl hair [3][4]. However, one reviewer found it a bit difficult to use compared to regular irons [5].

claims.text: One reviewer calls it an excellent price [1].
Reviewers say it works better than regular irons for hair that doesn't hold curls [3][4].
One reviewer found it a bit difficult to use [5].
